description: Build multi-page spreads (gatefolds and fold-outs, up to 10 pages) and split pages out of spreads, as dragging pages in the Pages panel does: keep a spread together (Allow Selected Spread to Shuffle off) or let it shuffle again, move a page into a spread, or split a page into a spread of its own

action.description: keep_together / allow_shuffle change a spread; add_page_to_spread moves pageIndex into spreadIndex; split_page moves pageIndex to a new spread of its own after its spread

pageIndex.description: The page to move (for add_page_to_spread and split_page)

position.description: Where the page goes in the spread

spreadIndex.description: The spread (for keep_together, allow_shuffle and add_page_to_spread)

name: arrange_spread_pages
title: Arrange Spread Pages
